fields.name: Devānanda (Vaidya, of Nityānanda's line)
fields.notes: A Vaidya by caste, of the disciple-line of Nityānanda Prabhu (Caitanya-bhāgavata 3.7.475; Caitanya-caritāmṛta Ādi 11.46). The Caitanya-bhāgavata names two persons called Devānanda; this is not Devānanda Paṇḍita, the Bhāgavata reader of Kuliyā (#203), whose life was in this record and went to his own record (06-11-2026).
